Pair with Steward

Connect this phone to the agent on your Mac.

First, add Steward to your Home Screen

  1. Tap Share at the bottom of Safari.
  2. Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.
  3. Open Steward from your Home Screen and enter the code there.

This makes it a real app with notifications. The code also works here if you’d rather use Safari.
